initialExam.title: IRDAI Assistant Manager 2026
initialExam.conductingBody: Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India
initialExam.description: IRDAI recruits Assistant Managers to regulate and promote insurance industry in India.
initialExam.eligibility: Bachelor's Degree with 60% marks or equivalent
initialExam.syllabus: Phase I: English, Reasoning, Quant, GA, Insurance Awareness. Phase II: Descriptive, Insurance domain knowledge.
initialExam.examPattern: Phase I: 200 marks online. Phase II: 100 marks. Interview: 50 marks.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Phase I → Phase II → Interview → Final Merit
initialExam.jobRole: Assistant Manager in IRDAI for insurance regulation
initialExam.careerGrowth: AM → Deputy Director → Director → ED through promotions.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit irdai.gov.in 2. Register 3. Apply 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Medical, Pension, LTC, Housing Loan
